items.title: claude-mem leads github trending with 1,723 stars today
items.summary:
it captures what an agent does in a session, compresses it with ai and feeds the relevant context back into later sessions, across claude code, codex, gemini, hermes and opencode.
107,172 stars total, typescript, apache-2.0, and it was pushed again this morning.

items.title: claude code game studios adds 1,347 stars with a 49-agent studio setup
items.summary:
it turns claude code into a game dev studio with 49 agents, 72 workflow skills and a coordination layer that mirrors a studio hierarchy.
30,771 stars total, shell, mit, and the last push was on 19 october.

items.title: impeccable adds 1,339 stars as the agent design toolkit passes 97,000
items.summary:
a design vocabulary for coding agents: commands like polish, bolder, critique and audit steer the output and catch ai slop before it ships.
97,786 stars total, rust, apache-2.0, and today's 1,339 is down from the 2,299 in yesterday's build.

items.title: openmausbot gains 1,304 stars as an open-source grok bot alternative
items.summary:
an open-source take on grok bot where each bot gets a virtual machine it can use.
9,269 stars total, typescript, apache-2.0, created in august and pushed this morning.

items.title: t3code adds 1,148 stars and sits at #5 on trendshift
items.summary:
a typescript ai coding assistant from ping.gg; its github description is empty, so the listing is the only summary.
33,951 stars total, mit, and it was pushed this afternoon.

items.title: vercel labs' agent-desktop tops trendshift's daily list
items.summary:
a rust tool that lets agents operate desktop apps through the os accessibility tree, with stable refs and retry-safe actions, instead of guessing from pixels.
3,446 stars on github, apache-2.0, created in february and pushed this morning; trendshift ranks it #1 today.

items.title: unslop, a claude skill that fixes ai-looking ui, hits #2 on trendshift in two days
items.summary:
a claude skill that turns vibecoded, ai-looking interfaces into designed ones.
2,641 stars two days after the repo was created, javascript, cc-by-4.0.

items.title: deeptutor picks up 1,035 stars for lifelong personalised tutoring
items.summary:
an open-source tutor built around lifelong, personalised learning, python under apache-2.0.
52,388 stars total and it was pushed again this morning.

items.title: araghchi calls the vance letter a "positive step" and says a two-day hormuz reopening plan is on the table
items.summary:
iran's foreign minister told al jazeera that talks with qatari mediators have cut the implementation period for iran's hormuz proposal to two days, and that mediators have tabled nuclear proposals.
he said there are no plans to meet us officials, and tehran still wants sanctions relief, restored oil waivers and frozen funds, including those held in Qatar.
items.change: araghchi called the vance letter a "positive step" and put a two-day timeline on the hormuz reopening, while ruling out a meeting with us officials for now.

items.title: khamenei orders forces to answer any attack "without geographical restriction"
items.summary:
his office said he met senior commanders on saturday and gave "important strategic directives" demanding maximum deterrence, as reports say the us and israel are preparing new strikes.
several iranian lawmakers also called for leaving the nuclear non-proliferation treaty, and a chatham house analyst says the sides remain split over hormuz versus the nuclear file.
items.change: the supreme leader's office ordered a response with no geographic limit on saturday, and lawmakers added calls to leave the npt.

items.title: trump says the war will be "wrapped up" soon while experts warn new strikes will not break iran
items.summary:
senator chris murphy called the reported plan "insane", and the nuclear threat initiative's eric brewer says there is no military solution for the remaining nuclear sites.
brewer expects iran to retaliate across the region and make the war longer, and a former iranian diplomat says tehran is slow-walking talks until next week's us midterms.
items.change: the debate moved from the classified briefing to expert pushback on what strikes could achieve, with the midterms framing both sides' timing.

items.title: iran says a us drone hit fishing boats off qeshm as seafarers stay stuck in hormuz
items.summary:
iranian state tv said two fishermen reported missing after a "us attack" on their boats off qeshm island were found, while fars said two others were injured.
dw reports seafarers stuck in the strait are desperate, and brent's december contract expired at $117.64 on friday after a tanker was hit.
items.change: the new incident is off qeshm on the iranian side, and iranian media blame a us drone; yesterday's oman rescue is no longer the lead.

items.title: a hostile drone is downed over the riyadh region for the second day running
items.summary:
the saudi-led coalition said it destroyed the drone on saturday with no casualties reported; on friday the kingdom said drones were downed near mecca, medina and riyadh, plus a missile fired toward the south.
at the manama dialogue, deputy foreign minister waleed elkhereiji said saudi arabia is pairing diplomacy with stronger defences and condemned the houthi escalation.
items.change: a second riyadh-region interception in two days, and riyadh is now making its public case at the manama dialogue.

items.title: an investigation says russian satellites watched 40 houthi strike zones on saudi arabia
items.summary:
ap reported that aurorah geosignal intelligence found russian military satellites observing the target areas before and after each of 40 attacks between 1 july and 19 october.
analyst elijah magnier cautions it does not show who had access to the imagery or whether russia shared it deliberately.
items.change: new reporting this week links russian satellite coverage to the houthi campaign, though attribution of any data sharing is unproven.

items.title: un says 290,000 are displaced in yemen since august, with 600 women due to give birth within two weeks
items.summary:
ocha counts at least 290,000 displaced since fighting resumed, including about 6,100 pregnant women, and aid has reached around 249,000 people.
taiz officials say 1.3 million people live under the houthi blockade and only 8.2 percent of water needs are met, though fighting eased in lahij's sa'ila al-maqatara.
items.change: the un displacement figure now stands at 290,000 and taiz officials put numbers on the blockade, including water supply at 8.2 percent of need.

items.title: israel stays deadlocked as likud says arab parties "stole" the vote
items.summary:
netanyahu's bloc won 53 seats, eisenkot's 48 and the arab-led lists a record 19, so neither side has the 61 needed.
shin bet is probing alleged qatari and turkish funding, which qatar denies, and critics say the claim is meant to block eisenkot from working with arab parties.
items.change: al jazeera's saturday analysis frames the result as a deadlock with the arab parties watching from outside; the interference row from thursday is still running.

items.title: the s&p 500 drops 1.8% for its worst day since june as the nasdaq sheds 2.9%
items.summary:
the s&p 500 closed at 7,580.07, the nasdaq composite at 25,437.00 and the dow at 51,770.31 (-1.09%), while the vix rose 12.9% to 19.42.
the nasdaq lost 5.3% in october, its worst month since march 2025, and us futures reopen sunday evening new york time.

items.title: intel closes down about 29% and analysts say the dip is not an easy buy
items.summary:
the stock fell 28.6% on friday after intel guided the current quarter below expectations amid a slowdown in global pc sales.
cnbc reports several analysts cut price targets and cautions that buying the dip needs a long horizon.

items.title: tech was the worst sector at -4% while energy and staples held up
items.summary:
technology fell 3.97% and the nasdaq 100 fell 3.48%, while energy gained 1.92% and consumer staples 1.48%.
nvidia lost 4.22% and was the biggest drag on the s&p, followed by intel and amd, and 2,600 stocks rose against 7,192 that fell.

items.title: brent's december contract expires at $117.64, a six-month high, with october up 13.6%
items.summary:
wti settled at $104.12 (+2.08%) and the january brent contract at $113.43, and wti rose 15.2% in october.
reuters ties the move to hormuz tanker incidents and houthi attacks on saudi arabia, with both benchmarks at their highest settlements since late april.

items.title: exxon and chevron hit all-time highs as war refining profits double
items.summary:
exxon earned $15.4bn, double last year, and chevron $9.9bn, up nearly 200%, both beating estimates on diesel margins.
us diesel averaged $6.32 a gallon, more than 70% above a year ago, as attacks on refineries cut global capacity by millions of barrels a day.

items.title: week ahead: apple and palantir monday, midterms tuesday, jobs report friday
items.summary:
apple and palantir report monday after the close, amd on tuesday, and uber on wednesday morning with mcdonald's expected the same day.
tuesday brings the us midterms and jolts at 10:00 et, adp is wednesday, and the october jobs report lands friday at 8:30 et.

items.title: gold drops 3.3% to a one-year low as the 10-year yield sits near 4.93%
items.summary:
gold futures closed at $3,898.90, down $132.50, the lowest level since last october.
the 10-year treasury yield was 4.929%, down 1.2%, and energy, consumer staples and utilities were the strongest s&p sectors.

items.title: binance says the $6.3bn breach is the biggest crypto theft on record, with about $3bn frozen
items.summary:
binance says roughly $3 billion of the affected assets is frozen and that it will cover losses.
investigators told yahoo finance the hackers are moving funds across blockchains in ways they have not seen before, raising questions about ai help.

items.title: liverpool host arsenal sunday at 19:30 riyadh, with saka and saliba out and dowman banned
items.summary:
liverpool are chasing a sixth straight win in all competitions, and a win would cut arsenal's lead to three points, with andy madley refereeing.
arsenal also have madueke's ankle in doubt, while rice and calafiori trained and are expected to be available.

items.title: predicted xi: the same eleven from sports mole, this is anfield and fotmob
items.summary:
alisson; araujo, jacquet, van dijk, kerkez; mac allister, gravenberch; barcola, wirtz, gakpo; isak.
isak has six goals in his last six premier league games, and wirtz has been involved in three goals in his last four.

items.title: szoboszlai and munoz both have a chance of making sunday
items.summary:
iraola said the pair, out for the last three games with a hamstring problem and a knee knock, could be involved but he is not certain.
frimpong is out until after the november break, with leoni, bradley and ekitike still sidelined.

items.title: iraola says mac allister "wants to stay" while the contract question stays open
items.summary:
the guardian says mac allister has become indispensable in midfield, and iraola called him "a top player" who has made his intentions clear.
goal reports the club has not offered an extension; reliability: guardian is reporting quotes, goal is a secondary summary.

items.title: liverpool reportedly step up interest in monaco's lamine camara
items.summary:
the sun says liverpool asked the senegal midfielder's camp to keep them informed, and goal says they are ahead of chelsea, who have turned to bournemouth's alex scott.
a january deal would need compromises from all three parties, so a summer move looks likelier; this is a tabloid report relayed by goal and is unconfirmed.

meta.reliability: low-medium: tabloid (The Sun) via Goal, unconfirmed

items.title: bournemouth at home in the quarter-finals after arsenal's fleetwood shock
items.summary:
liverpool host bournemouth in the week starting december 14, while fleetwood town, who beat arsenal on penalties, host everton.
arsenal's midweek also ended with a red card for 16-year-old max dowman that carries a three-match ban, upheld on appeal.

items.title: araujo's £47m option looks a formality and johnson says wait on a right-back
items.summary:
the uruguayan has played all 13 games on loan from barcelona, mostly at right-back with frimpong and bradley out, and his agent has spoken about his future.
glen johnson says liverpool should see how bradley returns before buying a specialist right-back.

items.title: kuyt takes interim charge of fenerbahce before facing liverpool
items.summary:
liverpool confirmed the former forward has been put in interim charge of fenerbahce, who meet the reds in the champions league next week.
kuyt was assistant to ismail kartal and made 285 appearances for liverpool between 2006 and 2012.
